item.name: Angry Munci
item.spawnContext: Public special round focused on Angry Munci (and multi-Munci variants)
item.ability: High friction AI that turns quickly, does not accelerate like normal bots, and is much harder to juke. Sight-gated full speed. Cannot reliably teleport like average nextbots.
item.cardSummary: Signature hard special nextbot with a large speed boost and sticky chase AI that punishes clustering and dead ends.

item.ability: 3D nextbot. Uses its speed boost when it spots a player. Map-locked to Backrooms maps.
item.cardSummary: 3D Backrooms Bacteria nextbot that only appears on Backrooms maps and ramps speed on sight.
